rule: SMB Put credit spread campaign: 5d, delta 0.3, width 2%, PT 0%
description: SMB put credit spreads [6VPPI-MNUDM, nvJ_43579z8]: sell a ~30-delta put, buy one ~2% lower, weekly cadence - the May-2024 controlled experiment (40-delta PCS 12/12 wins while call-buying went 3W/10L on the same days) is the corpus's sharpest evidence for this structure. Hold to expiry; defined risk = width - credit. Parameters here: 5 trading days, short-leg delta 0.3, width 2%, profit-take 0% (all editable via --smb-dte/--smb-delta/--smb-width-pct/--smb-profit-take-pct). Continuous campaign: a new cycle opens at the close whenever flat. r = cycle P&L / max risk; 1% of equity per cycle.
note: BSM-priced from our quote history; expiry settles intrinsic; NOT modeled: early assignment, dividends, vol smile, intraday management, earnings-date and 0DTE/intraday SMB strategies (need event/intraday data - disclosed out of scope).
